rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for a purposeful gathering of people, including a school assembly.

example.english: There’s a school assembly tomorrow, so remember to come back early.
example.traditional: 學校聽日有集會，記得早啲返嚟。
example.jyutping: hok6 haau6 ting1 jat6 jau5 zaap6 wui2 gei3 dak1 zou2 di1 faan1 lei4

rows.note: Use this for a large formal assembly or a named body such as the United Nations General Assembly, rather than for an ordinary gathering or a generic legislature.

example.english: The United Nations General Assembly will meet next week.
example.traditional: 聯合國大會下星期開會。
example.jyutping: lyun4 hap6 gwok3 daai6 wui6 haa6 sing1 kei4 hoi1 wui5

rows.note: Use this for the process of putting parts together, especially in contexts such as products, furniture, or computers.

example.english: This desk requires assembly; the instructions are here.
example.traditional: 呢張書枱要自己組裝，說明書喺度。
example.jyutping: ni1 zoeng1 syu1 toi2 jiu3 zi6 gei2 zou2 zong1 syut3 ming4 syu1 hai2 dou6

rows.note: Use this for a legislative assembly or other body that debates and makes laws.

example.english: The assembly voted on the new bill today.
example.jyutping: ji5 wui6 gam1 jat6 biu2 kyut3 san1 faat3 on3
